newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas, union in final talks.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas, union in final talks.

text.p: Negotiators for McDonnell Douglas Corp and the striking International Association of Machinists met Tuesday for final talks before the union votes Wednesday on the company's contract offer.
Federal mediator Richard Horn said the two sides would not bargain on Tuesday. "We are here to make sure all the questions are answered on the package," Horn said.

Company executives and union officials hammered out a tentative agreement last week that could end the strike, which has affected 6,700 workers. The machinists struck June 5. The main issue is job security.

The machinists are set to vote on the contract proposal at 1300 CDT/1800 GMT on Wednesday. Union officials said they would not recommend a vote either for or against the proposal, leaving members to decide for themselves.
